test_cases.title: Navigate from a product listing to matching product detail and back
preconditions: A user can establish the authenticated state required by the feature through the visible login flow.
test_data_requirements: Select one product that is visibly present in the product listing and retain its displayed name and price as runtime reference values.
The exploratory session observed Sauce Labs Backpack with a displayed price of $29.99; the test must compare the values captured at runtime rather than assume a fixed catalog value.

steps.action: Authenticate through the visible login flow.
steps.expected_result: The authenticated product listing is displayed.

steps.action: Select one visible product from the product listing.
steps.expected_result: The selected product's detail view is displayed.

steps.action: Capture the selected product name from the listing as the runtime reference productName.
steps.expected_result: productName contains the selected product name visible in the listing.

steps.action: Capture the selected product price from the listing as the runtime reference productPrice.
steps.expected_result: productPrice contains the selected product price visible in the listing.

steps.action: Inspect the product detail view for the selected product.
steps.expected_result: The product detail view visibly contains a product name and a product price.

steps.action: Compare the product name in the detail view with productName.
steps.expected_result: The detail-view product name exactly matches productName.

steps.action: Compare the product price in the detail view with productPrice.
steps.expected_result: The detail-view product price exactly matches productPrice.

steps.action: Return to the product listing using the browser's back navigation.
steps.expected_result: The browser returns to the product-listing page.

steps.action: Inspect the product-listing page after returning.
steps.expected_result: The product listing is visible again at https://www.saucedemo.com/inventory.html.

expected_results: An authenticated user can open a visible product's detail view from the product listing.
The detail-view product name matches the name captured for the selected listing item.
The detail-view product price matches the price captured for the selected listing item.
Returning from the detail view makes the product listing visible again at https://www.saucedemo.com/inventory.html.
